messages:
maya: quick heads-up — I'm rolling out a routing-policy flag in the console (canary 10%). tile now shows "fallback enabled" for some accounts. seeing unexpected client fallbacks, esp Python.

sam: :eyes: saw a spike in fallbacks at 09:12. logs show requests missing our route hint header.

aj: looks like client libs aren't attaching `x-rd-route` when the console toggles via new flag. stack trace points to our request wrapper.

sasha: console UX change didn't update the rollout wiring. tile toggles UI state but feature-flag service returns old value for half the users.

maya: repro steps:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
note: missing header `x-rd-route: policy=canary-v2` causes fallback.

sam: telemetry: we should emit `route_hint.mismatch` counter and a tag for sdk.language. that'll help quantify impact.

aj: agreed. also sending a WARN log from SDK when route header absent would cut down debugging time.

sasha: console: add tooltip explaining "fallback enabled" and a link to recent mismatches. product wants numbers not just on/off.

maya: plan: pause flag rollout, add telemetry, ship python client patch to opt-in route-hint via config, then resume canary with 1% increments.

sam: patch idea: env var `RD_ROUTE_HINT_MODE=opt-in|opt-out|always` default to opt-in to avoid breaking change. add metric emission behind flag.

aj: will draft the python PR. simple wrapper change and a WARN log + metric emit.

sasha: I'll update console tile copy and add mismatches count. also adding an event link to the logs page.

deploy-bot: canary pause requested by @maya — stopping rollout in region us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all. follow-ups: jira RD-4021 (python patch), RD-4022 (telemetry metric), RD-4023 (console tooltip + tile counts). I'll assign and ping when ready. :thumbsup:
